title: Same three-layer pattern, three real production platforms
rows: Kubernetes Agent Sandbox (CNCF SIG, 2026 - official reference for AI agents / untrusted code on k8s)
Host-level L2/L3 segmentation below the pods
Gitpod / Ona (dev-workspace platform, millions of parallel workspaces)
Cilium (eBPF) network policies + dedicated tunnels - tenants can't ping each other
Envoy ingress, subdomain + session-cookie routing, zero raw ports to internet
Fly.io (production VM hosting - different sandbox tech, same 3-layer shape)
Firecracker microVMs (hardware-virtualized, own guest kernel per tenant)
Proprietary L2 network "6PN" - no local route between VMs
fly-proxy (Rust) - TLS termination + identity-based routing straight into the VM
